# Lab 16.10: Build a Custom Agent with ADK & MCP

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a small Python agent with the Agent Development Kit (ADK) that uses BigQuery tools, and connect an AI coding tool to BigQuery through the BigQuery MCP server.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Install ADK.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">pip install --quiet google-adk
mkdir -p bq_agent &amp;&amp; cd bq_agent</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Write the agent.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; agent.py &lt;&lt;'EOF'
from google.adk.agents import Agent
from google.adk.tools.bigquery import BigQueryToolset, BigQueryCredentialsConfig
from google.adk.tools.bigquery.config import BigQueryToolConfig, WriteMode
import google.auth

creds, _ = google.auth.default()
bq_tools = BigQueryToolset(
    credentials_config=BigQueryCredentialsConfig(credentials=creds),
    bigquery_tool_config=BigQueryToolConfig(write_mode=WriteMode.BLOCKED),
)

root_agent = Agent(
    name="bq_helper",
    model="gemini-3.5-flash",
    instruction="You answer questions about BigQuery data. Always look at table schemas before writing SQL. Never modify data.",
    tools=[bq_tools],
)
EOF
echo "from . import agent" &gt; __init__.py
cd ..
adk run bq_agent</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Ask: *"How many orders are in bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders by status?"* `WriteMode.BLOCKED` stops the agent from changing data.

3. **[CLI] Connect Gemini CLI to the BigQuery MCP server.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p ~/.gemini
cat &gt; ~/.gemini/settings.json &lt;&lt;'EOF'
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "bigquery": {
      "httpUrl": "https://bigquery.googleapis.com/mcp",
      "authProviderType": "google_credentials"
    }
  }
}
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Start `gemini` in Cloud Shell and run `/mcp` to see the BigQuery tools. Ask it to list datasets in your project. If the endpoint is not found, check the **BigQuery MCP server** page in the docs for the current URL and how to enable it.

4. **[Console] Audit what the agent did.** Every query from ADK or MCP is a normal BigQuery job. Open **Personal history** to see them.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| ADK | Python agents with BigQuery tools |
| Safety | Read-only mode with `WriteMode.BLOCKED` |
| MCP | Any MCP client can use BigQuery tools |
| Audit | Every agent query is a visible job |
